summary: The diff implements most of the required changes: DashboardHeader Save/Load buttons removed (REQ-1), backend romUsageCount field added with migration and increment method (REQ-3), ProjectContext exposes romUsageCount and incrementRomUsage (REQ-5), and ReservesProductionSection implements ROM limit logic with upgrade prompt (REQ-4). However, REQ-2 requires complete removal of SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from all rendering locations, but the diff shows SaveProjectModal still exists as a file and there is no evidence of its removal from DashboardPage or other components.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from any other locations where they are rendered or triggered. SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal should not be rendered anywhere in the application and no orphaned state or handlers related to save/load project should remain active in the UI.
